trained_on: DARPA TC E5 FiveDirections (smoke subset: files 1-2)
limitations: Trained on a single campaign (E5 FiveDirections) - generalization to other teams (THEIA, TRACE, CADETS) or engagements (E3, E4) is UNVERIFIED.
All 86 attacks cluster in a 2-minute window; stratified (not temporal) split means this measures discrimination, not temporal robustness.
Small attack sample size (~86 windows) limits statistical power.
Features derived from 1-second graph windows; multi-step APTs spanning minutes/hours are not captured by this model alone.
